rulings.evidence: Two distinct pantry foods on one unsplittable line, so no single bid can carry it; follows the 'garlic powder, cumin, and chili powder' precedent of 2026-08-26. Pantry-static pricing at a pinch is safe.
Vocabulary row Yellow Onion [onions] is same form and the board carries onions 7 of 7; an unqualified 'onion' in a savoury braise is the yellow cooking onion, not the red variety.

apples is a LIVE board id (7 of 7 stores) so this is a REUSE, not a new id; Fuji is a mainstream bagged eating apple sold at the generic apple price, unlike the red-onion variety-pricing case. The missing piece is a vocabulary ROW named Apples, a naming question.
The DIFFERENT FORM 'ground' flag is spurious: a 1/4 tsp measure of cinnamon IS ground cinnamon, not a stick. Board carries ground-cinnamon 7 of 7.
Same spurious form flag: 1/8 tsp is a ground-spice measure, not a whole nutmeg. Board carries ground-nutmeg 5 of 7.
